clips.title: The story
paras: At the Valley of Kings, stone kings watch the southern road into the Searing Gorge. The canyon lies in southwestern Loch Modan, south of the passage to Dun Morogh. Blackrock forces and troggs threaten travelers beneath the dwarven monuments.

Two immense statues of King Madoran Bronzebeard and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer watch over the southern pass. After the kings died, their sons jointly commissioned the carvings. The statues honor the allied victory in the War of the Three Hammers and face the Dark Iron clan. Beyond them, the southern lands still bear the ruin left by Ragnaros's summoning.

The valley links South Gate Pass with Stonesplinter Valley and holds an iron gate into the Searing Gorge. Hostile Blackrock orcs, Dark Iron dwarves, and volcanic dangers make the passage perilous, so Ironforge mountaineers keep the gate locked and guarded. Mountaineer Pebblebitty watches the threshold. Only the hardiest travelers who can show they have the strength to survive beyond it may pass.
